description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatSheetContent class in the Android app, specifically testing the behavior of functions related to handling pending assistant auto-sends in the chat UI.

classes.name: ChatSheetContentTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing chat assistant message dispatch and pending auto-send handling.

methods.name: resolvesPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Tests that resolvePendingAssistantAutoSend returns null when conditions are not met and correctly returns the prompt when it is valid.

methods.name: keepsPendingAssistantAutoSendWhenDispatchRejected
methods.description: Tests that dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend does not mark the prompt as consumed if the dispatch callback returns false.

methods.name: clearsPendingAssistantAutoSendOnlyAfterAcceptedDispatch
methods.description: Tests that dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend marks the prompt as consumed when the dispatch callback returns true.
